parsing.colAvailabilityHint: The server probes parser catalog URLs with HTTP GET (which URLs depends on PLP vs PDP). Green means all probed pages succeeded; red means none; yellow means some. Refreshes when you save the schedule or use Run now, and periodically for active schedules (roughly every 10+ minutes).
parsing.registrySyncInfo999md: Rebuilds the 999.md import registry and partner fields on Kupito listings by matching live profile listings (GraphQL) against your vehicle listings in the database (VIN first, then a strict fingerprint). Only unambiguous matches are written. Requires the same import credentials on the server as CLI import.
parsing.registrySyncInfoCipauto: Seeds the CipAuto import registry from existing Kupito listings for this partner user, using Cod produs from listing descriptions and updating partner fields. Does not read the PLP snapshot; safe to run after a fresh PLP scan.
parsing.registrySyncAssignedUserHint: Must be the partner account whose listings are matched. Prefilled when a recent PDP/PLP run used this PLP file with an assigned user.
parsing.registrySyncLoginMismatch: The login stored in this PLP file does not match the file name. Fix the snapshot or pick the correct file.

parsing.fieldResumeHint: Continues the latest unfinished run for this parser so processing does not restart from scratch.
parsing.fieldDryRunHint: Runs the process in test mode without applying final changes so you can inspect logs and results first.

contact.description: If you have additional questions not covered here, please contact us at

partners.title: For partners
partners.intro: Kupito works with car dealers and other automotive businesses that regularly publish up-to-date listings and need an additional sales channel. The partner program helps automate listing publication, improve listing visibility, and present your company on the platform in a more structured way.

howToBecome.title: Joining the partner program
items: Contact us through the Contacts page and briefly describe your company, operating model, and approximate listing volume.
Participation is available to accounts registered on the platform as legal entities.
After your request, we will clarify the cooperation details and, if needed, help configure automatic listing synchronization with your website or other platforms.

benefits.title: Opportunities for partners
items: Automatic listing synchronization with your website or other platforms, with no manual data duplication.
Free promotion bonuses for regular publication: every 20 new listings adds 1 free promotion to the profile balance, which can be used to promote selected listings.
A partner label on listing pages and on the seller's public listings board.
Placement of your company logo and link in the Kupito footer.
A more convenient channel for keeping an up-to-date vehicle catalog on the platform.

whoCan.title: Who the program is for
items: Car dealers, showrooms, importers, and other companies that regularly publish vehicle listings.
Companies must use a legal entity account; private sellers can continue using the standard platform terms.
At this stage, participation in the partner program is provided free of charge.

howToLeave.title: Changes to cooperation terms
items: If the cooperation format needs to be changed or completed, contact us through the Contacts page.
We will agree on the next steps and update the partner status, footer placement, and available promotion bonuses carefully.
Detailed conditions for partner status and bonuses are governed by the Terms of Service and by individual agreements when they are arranged separately.

obligations.title: Mutual expectations
items: Partnership is based on accurate listing information, timely data updates, and respectful communication with platform users.
We welcome mentions of Kupito on partner websites and social media, as well as referrals to customers who may benefit from listing a vehicle on the platform.

investors.title: For investors
investors.intro: Kupito.club is building a technology platform for automotive listings, focused on a convenient user experience, listing automation, and the ability to scale into new markets.

about.title: About the project
paragraphs: In many markets, the experience of searching for and publishing vehicle listings remains fragmented: users lack a convenient interface, clear information, and modern tools for working with listings.
Kupito.club is designed as a reusable product and technical foundation that can be adapted to local markets, languages, listing rules, partner integrations, and demand patterns.

done.title: What we have so far
items: A live platform in Moldova as the first market for product validation
A modern interface for searching, viewing, and managing listings
Initial partners from the automotive market
Automatic listing synchronization with external sources
Early users, traffic, and practical product feedback

product.title: Product
product.lead: The platform brings together the main journeys for buyers, sellers, and partners:
items: Free listing publication
Easy search and comparison of listings
Saving listings to favorites
Saving search filters
The option to get short AI-generated informational summaries for eligible vehicle listings (signed-in users; subject to availability and limits)
A public listings board with all listings from one seller on a single page
Automatic listing synchronization for partners
A mobile-first interface, PWA installation, and an Android app on Google Play (TWA)

businessModel.title: Business model
items: Paid listing promotion
Advertising placements and partner integrations
Premium features for active users
B2B tools for dealers and professional sellers

vision.title: Vision
paragraphs: Our goal is to build modern infrastructure for automotive listings that can be developed consistently in a local market and then adapted to other countries with similar needs.

strategy.title: Growth strategy
items: Strengthening the product and user journeys in Moldova
Gradually scaling marketing and organic acquisition
Growing the partner network of dealers and professional sellers
Preparing a repeatable launch model for new markets

scaling.title: Scaling
scaling.lead: After the product and commercial model are validated, launches may be considered in markets with similar demand patterns and similar issues in the automotive listings segment:
items: Eastern Europe
Balkans
Latin America
Africa
Asia

whyNow.title: Why now
items: In many countries, the automotive listings market remains insufficiently convenient and technology-driven
Users increasingly expect a mobile interface, fast search, and higher-quality vehicle information
Car dealers and professional sellers need tools for automating publication and keeping catalogs up to date

offer.title: Investment offer
offer.lead: We are open to investment and strategic partnerships to:
items: Accelerate product development and analytical tools
Expand marketing and the partner network
Prepare the platform for launches in new markets
offer.footer: We are ready to discuss cooperation format, current metrics, and the next stages of project development on request.

pwa.iosStep3: Confirm by tapping 'Add' in the top right corner. The app will appear on your home screen
pwa.androidStep0: Open Chrome browser on your Android phone and go to kupito.club
pwa.androidStep1: Tap the three dots icon (⋮) in the top right corner of the browser to open the menu
pwa.androidStep2: In the menu, select 'Add to Home Screen'
pwa.androidStep3: Confirm by tapping 'Add'. The app will appear on your home screen
